findings.reason: as written the mutation targets the sliced search, not the per-run-file placement the first case guards; the control must also disable the addition scan (or be reworded to reroute that run through the search) or the node's new placement mechanism ships with no failing control.
findings.text: the first case asserts that a run with a per-run file is placed without a `-p` log, but the mutation named to redden it ("Routing every missing id through one unsliced `-G` search") leaves the per-run-file addition scan in place, so such a run is still placed by the scan and never becomes "missing" — the first case stays green and the control proves nothing about the mechanism it is meant to guard
